test_case.test_name: Coherent Link Features: NVLink and C2C - C2C Error — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Validate an engineering-defined C2C coherent-link error between the intended NVIDIA components, including detection, containment, persistent reporting, coherent-data behavior and recovery without substituting a different NVLink or register fault.
required_package: Authoritative definition of the C2C Error class and covered protocol layer
Pinned NVIDIA C2C/NVLink RAS tool/spec/version/checksum and supported silicon/firmware/driver/OS
Exact source/destination endpoint, link/lane/direction/instance and topology map
Stimulus command plus severity, containment/reset and raw status/counter/log signature
Coherent memory/traffic ordering, poison/data-integrity, peer availability and deadline criteria
Independent OOB/console/fabric recovery, aborts, clear policy and restoration
test_case.test_command: Block execution now. Future method identifies the C2C endpoints, link/lane/direction and error class, baselines authoritative link/coherency counters and peer memory state, injects one vendor-defined error, correlates raw component-specific evidence, and proves peer/link availability plus coherent memory/data recovery.
